label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Rick, I need you to actually read this, so I'm putting it all in one message.

You told Gary I'd list his house at 1% as a "family rate." I never agreed to that, and I never said 1% to anybody. My listing rate is 2.5%. You quoted my commission to your buddy without asking me first. Then I spent my whole Saturday on it: pulled comps, did the walkthrough, printed a full listing packet. That's six hours plus the drive from north Phoenix. Sunday night Gary texted that he's going with ListLite for $3,995. "No hard feelings." When I called you about it, you said, "That's business, sis, can't win 'em all."

That's not business. That's me doing work for free because you made a promise with my name on it.

And now this morning you texted that Denise from work wants to pick my brain about her rental, and you'd already given her my cell. Same thing happened with your softball guy two years ago, and I let it go. I'm not letting it go this time.

So here's where things stand:

1. Don't give out my number to anyone without asking me first. Every time.
2. Don't quote my commission or any rate for me. That's my call, not yours.
3. I'm not calling Denise. If she wants to talk about her rental, you can tell her that.

I'm not mad at Gary. He got a quote and went with the cheaper option, and I get that. I'm mad at you. You get to look like the guy who has everything handled with your friends, and I end up doing the work.

I'll always help family for free. Mom, your kids, anybody who needs advice from me, I'm glad to do it. What I'm not doing is being your free sales department.

I'm still pissed. But I'm not walking away from you, and I'll see you at Thanksgiving at your place like we planned. I just need you to get this straight before then.

Call me when you've read this.
